papers.title: Leveraging Acoustic Cues and Paralinguistic Embeddings to Detect Expression from Voice
alternate_titles: Leveraging Acoustic Cues and Paralinguistic Embeddings to Detect Expression from Voice
authors: Vikramjit MitraSue BookerErik MarchiDavid Scott FarrarUte Dorothea PeitzBridget ChengErmine TevesAnuj MehtaDevang Naik

papers.title: FoundationDB Record Layer: A Multi-Tenant Structured Datastore
alternate_titles: FoundationDB Record Layer: A Multi-Tenant Structured Datastore
papers.abstract: The FoundationDB Record Layer is an open source library that provides a record-oriented data store with semantics similar to a relational database implemented on top of FoundationDB, an ordered, transactional key-value store. The Record Layer provides a lightweight, highly extensible way to store structured data. It offers schema management and a rich set of query and indexing facilities, some of which are not usually found in traditional...

papers.title: Bandwidth Embeddings for Mixed-Bandwidth Speech Recognition
alternate_titles: Bandwidth Embeddings for Mixed-Bandwidth Speech Recognition
papers.abstract: In this paper, we tackle the problem of handling narrowband and wideband speech by building a single acoustic model (AM), also called mixed bandwidth AM. In the proposed approach, an auxiliary input feature is used to provide the bandwidth information to the model, and bandwidth embeddings are jointly learned as part of acoustic model training. papers.title: Implicit generation and generalization methods for energy-based models
alternate_titles: Implicit generation and generalization methods for energy-based models
papers.abstract: We’ve made progress towards stable and scalable training of energy-based models (EBMs) resulting in better sample quality and generalization ability than existing models. Generation in EBMs spends more compute to continually refine its answers and doing so can generate samples competitive with GANs at low temperatures, while also having mode coverage guarantees of likelihood-based models. We hope these findings stimulate further research into this promising class of models.

papers.title: Sliced Wasserstein Discrepancy for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation

papers.abstract: In this work, we connect two distinct concepts for unsupervised domain adaptation: feature distribution alignment between domains by utilizing the task-specific decision boundary and the Wasserstein metric. papers.title: Neural MMO: A massively multiagent game environment
alternate_titles: Neural MMO: A massively multiagent game environment
papers.abstract: We’re releasing a Neural MMO, a massively multiagent game environment for reinforcement learning agents. Our platform supports a large, variable number of agents within a persistent and open-ended task. The inclusion of many agents and species leads to better exploration, divergent niche formation, and greater overall competence.
